targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, argMax(event_count, calculated_at) AS event_count, concat(topic_name, ' p', toString(kafka_partition)) AS series FROM event_quality_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND consumer_group_id = '' GROUP BY window_start, topic_name, kafka_partition ORDER BY time

panels.title: Duplicates / schema violations / out of order

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, argMax(duplicate_count, calculated_at) AS duplicates, argMax(schema_violation_count, calculated_at) AS schema_violations, argMax(out_of_order_count, calculated_at) AS out_of_order FROM event_quality_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND consumer_group_id = '' GROUP BY window_start, topic_name, kafka_partition ORDER BY time

SELECT window_start AS time, max(dlq_count) AS dlq, max(max_event_delay_ms) AS event_delay_ms, max(max_processing_latency_ms) AS processing_latency_ms FROM (SELECT window_start, topic_name, kafka_partition, consumer_group_id, argMax(dlq_count, calculated_at) AS dlq_count, argMax(max_event_delay_ms, calculated_at) AS max_event_delay_ms, argMax(max_processing_latency_ms, calculated_at) AS max_processing_latency_ms FROM event_quality_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY window_start, topic_name, kafka_partition, consumer_group_id) GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY time

SELECT window_start AS time, argMax(consumer_lag_messages, calculated_at) AS consumer_lag, concat(consumer_group_id, ' / ', topic_name, ' p', toString(kafka_partition)) AS series FROM event_quality_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND consumer_group_id != '' GROUP BY window_start, topic_name, kafka_partition, consumer_group_id ORDER BY time
